verdicts.reason: A is a clean banner: the bottle sits on the yellow circle at left and a centred stack of wordmark, headline, subtitle and CTA follows a clear order. Its flaws are a very small subtitle at banner size and an empty green circle at right that adds weight but no content. B is jammed: the headline is oversized, nearly touches the bottle and runs into the circles at right, which now overlap each other in a muddy cluster. B's wordmark is also stranded at the far left, away from the bottle, the subtitle wraps into a cramped three-line block, and the CTA is pushed against the right edge, so nothing breathes and the brand stops reading as one unit.
